content: 2) We present a carefully designed and rigorous language-agnostic translation and annotation protocol. These well-defined guidelines will facilitate the development of future Multi-SimLex datasets for other languages. The proposed protocol eliminates some crucial issues with prior efforts focused on the creation of multi-lingual semantic resources, namely: i) limited coverage; ii) heterogeneous annotation guidelines; and iii) concept pairs which are semantically incomparable across different languages.
